$comment: Source registry (spec section 30). `redistribution_allowed` and `authorization_status` are set by a human after review, never by the pipeline. `trust_tier` records how the stream reached us and is what the publish gate reads.

trust_tiers.broadcaster_official: Published by the rights holder on its own domain for open web playback.
trust_tiers.fast_platform: A free ad-supported platform (Amagi, Rakuten, Samsung TV+, Tubi, Xumo, Wurl, Frequency, Pluto) distributing under its own licences.
trust_tiers.aggregator: A third-party aggregator or CDN re-serving channels; the rights position is not visible to us.

sources.name: User-supplied working playlist (Channel_List.txt)
sources.notes: Snapshot provided by the repository owner and stored verbatim at data/sources/imported-channel-list.m3u. Imported as-is for their own personal playback. Per-host trust tiers are recorded in host-trust.json; no entry is asserted to be licensed for redistribution.

sources.name: StreamIMDB
sources.notes: Phase 6. Metadata-only adapter. Every imported title defaults to playback_status=DISCOVERABLE; nothing from this source may enter a VOD playlist unless a direct playback URL is independently authorised.
